local function GQIME_fake_script() -- RoXploitButton.LocalScript 
	local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', RoXploitButton)

	script.Parent.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		loadstring(game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://364364477")[1].Source)()
	end)
end
coroutine.wrap(GQIME_fake_script)()
local function NBIBWF_fake_script() -- ExecuteButton.LocalScript 
	local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', ExecuteButton)

	script.Parent.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

end
coroutine.wrap(NBIBWF_fake_script)()
